text.name: Ana Montes Unmasked
text.rules: Record "mole exposed". LIO spends 1 point on actions. Until the end of this turn, each time SAE spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1.
text.history: Ana Montes, a senior analyst at the US Defense Intelligence Agency, was arrested on 21 September 2001 for spying for Cuba; she was sentenced to 25 years and released in January 2023.
